title: Stray Review - Nine Lives - GameSpot
quote: It’s a consistently satisfying adventure with a charming story about companionship that rarely misses a beat across its well-paced runtime.

title: Horizon Forbidden West Review - Squad Goals - GameSpot
quote: But while it casts an imposing shadow, Forbidden West often keeps its focus on characters and their stories, and that approach works to break the enormity into smaller chunks and give your adventure stakes that matter.

title: Horizon Forbidden West review - a gorgeous sequel that continues to borrow more than it adds | Eurogamer.net
quote: And, if you're anything like me, you will also take a lot of pictures - of swirling red sandstorms, snow-tipped mountains and views of sprawling forests. In truth, I can't calm down about the way Forbidden West looks. Someone made this, and you can walk around in it!

title: Gran Turismo 7 Review - Round We Go Again - GameSpot
quote: That’s the joy of Gran Turismo 7: You can always do better, you’ll always want to do better, and it’s just a few quick button stabs away.

title: Bayonetta 3 Review - Real Hot Girls Hit - GameSpot
quote: Like the titular witch, Bayonetta 3 feels as if it doesn’t much care how it is perceived because it knows its own worth as a game that offers fast and fluid gameplay, jaw-dropping spectacles, comedy, and camp in a way very few others do.

title: Kirby And The Forgotten Land Review - The Best Kirby Yet - GameSpot
quote: He smiles incessantly while waving his little arms and waddling on his disproportionate feet, and he’s always there to say “hiiiiii” in a cheerful manner.

title: Wardogs early access review - a shooter for the gig economy | Eurogamer.net
quote: Honestly, I could dedicate this whole article to discussing Wardogs' cash mechanic. But it's not the only thing that makes Bulkhead's FPS interesting. Wardogs' hybridisation of Battlefield and ArmA is itself noteworthy in how it manages to meld together the best aspects of both.
